strings.privacy.title: Laabi
strings.privacy.description: pdffusion siri i dosiyeeji baari waati di: mbindi tii, dosiyee tii siri, pub tii ani data tii taguuti.
strings.privacy.intro: pdffusion baaruuti ka i dosiyeeji siri i ta. Sira gari ra, a siri baari waati di.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: I dosiyeeji
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: A siri taara encrypted (HTTPS), baaruuti, ka taguuti a waati ra fota. Dosiyeeji boro siri temporary storage ra ka taji tabuuti ani taguuti waati kelen ra; automatic cleanup siri 24 hours ra.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Mbindi tii, personal data tii
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdffusion tii mbindi, email wala card sebi. I dosiyeeji tii kaari, tii seeri wala tii baara artificial intelligence ra.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kira
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Muna kira taji cookies tii (Vercel Web Analytics) ka gari baari taari. Pub tii, tracking tii.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie kelen: a siri kanni i sebi taari.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Hosting
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Site siri Vercel ra Paris; Word, Excel ani PowerPoint yeeliruuti siri Render ra Frankfurt. Server nne siri baara waati kelen ra.

strings.legal.terms.title: Baara sariyaw
strings.legal.terms.description: pdffusion bɛɛ nɔgɔma, fari ani jamana ka baara bɛ se ka kɛ. I ka sɛbɛnw bɛ i ta: hɛrɛ tɛ kɛ.

strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Min bɛ pdffusion kɛ

strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: I bɛ se ka sɛbɛn bɛɛ kɛ, fana kɔnɔba, sabu pdffusion tɛ kow kɛ, fari tɛ: a bɛ kɛ ka kɔrɔsɛbɛ. I bɛ i ta tiɲɛ, ani i bɛ i ka baara kɛ.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Kodi kɛla ani baara i ka sɛbɛnw na
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: pdffusion kodi MIT sariyaw kɔnɔ. I bɛ se ka a kalandi, i bɛ se ka a kɛ i ka sɛbɛn kɔnɔ, i bɛ se ka a yɛlɛma.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Baara mɛnɛ
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: I tɛ se ka pdffusion kɛ baara jugu la, i tɛ se ka baara tiɲɛ.
